translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.54:1: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺
verses.54:2: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”
verses.54:3: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—
verses.54:4: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent
verses.54:5: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺
verses.54:6: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying
verses.54:7: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts
verses.54:8: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
verses.54:9: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated
verses.54:10: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”
verses.54:11: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain
verses.54:12: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set
verses.54:13: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails
verses.54:14: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied
verses.54:15: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.54:16: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.54:17: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.54:18: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.54:19: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery
verses.54:20: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees
verses.54:21: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.54:22: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.54:24: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane
verses.54:25: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
verses.54:26: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is
verses.54:27: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience
verses.54:28: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”
verses.54:29: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺
verses.54:30: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.54:31: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders
verses.54:32: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.54:33: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings
verses.54:34: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn
verses.54:35: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks
verses.54:36: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings
verses.54:37: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”
verses.54:38: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment
verses.54:39: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”
verses.54:40: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.54:41: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh
verses.54:42: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful
verses.54:43: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books
verses.54:44: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”
verses.54:45: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee
verses.54:46: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter
verses.54:47: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes
verses.54:48: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
verses.54:49: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained
verses.54:50: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye
verses.54:51: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful
verses.54:52: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records
verses.54:53: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺
verses.54:54: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers
verses.54:55: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign
